questions.question: Please look... this word in the dictionary
questions.solution:
Exp: You would say "look up" a word in a dictionary. "Look up" is a phrasal verb that means to search for information in a reference book or online.

Additional Exp:This phrasal verb specifically means to search for information, especially in a reference work like a dictionary, encyclopedia, or online database. It implies a directed search for a specific piece of information. "I looked up the word 'fratricide' in the dictionary."

The historians / are a great / asset to the / field of academia.

• The error lies in the part "The historians."
 
• The definite article 'the' is used before a noun when one is referring to something specific.

questions.question: The protesting employees were asked to ________ their strike.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**call off**'.

• In the context of the sentence, the employees are asked to cancel their strike, which aligns with the meaning of "**call off**."
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are incorrect in this context because they do not convey the meaning of canceling the strike.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The protesting employees were asked to **call off**__ their strike."*

questions.question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Janet has / a pet dog / who are / very smart.
questions.solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"who are."** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"who are."**
 
• The verb **"are"** is incorrect because it does not agree with the singular subject** "pet dog".**
 
• According to **Subject-Verb agreement, **a plural subject takes a plural verb and a singular subject takes a singular verb.
 
• So, we need a singular helping verb **"is"** with the subject** "pet dog."**
 
• The correct verb should be **"is"** to match the singular subject.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

** Correct sentence **: *Janet has a pet dog **who is**__ very smart.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She __always do__ her work in time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. always does .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is "She," which is a third person singular subject.
 
• When using third person singular subjects (he, she, it) in the present simple tense, the verb should have an **-s** on the end.
 
• The verb "do" becomes "does" when used with third person singular subjects.

Correct sentence: *She always **does** her work in time.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Always will done:** This option is grammatically incorrect because "will done" is not a correct verb form.
 
• **Always done:** This option is ungrammatical because "done" is a past participle and cannot function as a main verb without an auxiliary verb.
 
• **Always doing:** This option uses the continuous form of the verb, which does not fit the context of a habitual action.

Testify
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Testify"** means to give evidence as a witness in a law court or to make a statement based on personal knowledge or belief. (गवाही देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was called to **testify **at the trial.
 
 
 
• **"Falsify"** means to alter information or evidence so as to mislead. It is the act of making something false. (झूठा बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of **falsifying **the financial records.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Testify' **is **'Falsify'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Example:** The fingerprints on the gun were **evidence **that he was at the crime scene.
 
 
 
• **Prove **(साबित करना): To demonstrate the truth or existence of something by evidence or argument.
 
 
• **Example: **He managed to **prove **his innocence.
 
 
 
• **Confide **(भरोसा करना): To tell someone about a secret or private matter while trusting them not to repeat it to others.
 
 
• **Example:** She **confided **in her best friend about her fears.
